part.text:
Done. Run with `npm start`, then open http://localhost:3000.

- `server.js` — dependency-free Node server: home page (currently reading / finished), add-book form, mark-finished button, and a shareable `/books/:id` page with title, author, and editable notes
- `lib/store.js` — JSON persistence to `data/books.json` (atomic writes, survives restarts)
- `public/style.css` — minimal styling
- `test/app.test.js` — 12 vitest tests covering store persistence, all routes, and HTML escaping; all passing
